name: Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples
description: Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples is a widely referenced benchmark dataset containing 5,932 images representing four critical rice leaf diseases: Bacterial Blight, Blast, Brown Spot, and Tungro. Captured under varied natural outdoor field environments, the dataset provides deep learning and support vector machine practitioners with authentic, high-variability visual symptoms across infection stages. Originally compiled and evaluated in landmark research published in Computers and Electronics in Agriculture, the dataset serves as an authoritative baseline for agricultural disease diagnostics, automated scouting algorithms, and mobile decision-support tools for rice farmers.
